protocol: Initial independent local audit on the frozen UX403 runtime. The first result is retained even on failure.
provenance: Two original narratives, 16 chronological authored sources each. Eight acts; long variant interleaves 126 synthetic shift entries per act. Both languages are translations, both sizes use identical probes.

scoring.wanted: All listed source IDs must appear in decoded story memory; a different source about the same object is insufficient.
scoring.exclude: Any explicitly excluded source is competing context. This is a precision measure, not evidence of a generated false answer. Other extras are allowed.
scoring.owner: For each selected required promise with an oracle owner, verify both the recorded promisor ID and display name. Missing attribution counts separately from missing facts.
scoring.notice: Required for ambiguous or unsupported references. For answerable when-missing cases expect a preparation warning iff a required source is absent. Quiet controls expect none. Count omissions and excess warnings separately.
scoring.falseComplete: A complete coverage claim on missing required facts or a required uncertainty warning is an error.
scoring.provenance: Check exact quotation, task, kind, stored roles and revision ID, token accounting and budget. Require cold/warm/reopened byte-equivalent compiler results and coverage, unchanged persisted records.
